title: AI starting-grid offsets
description: Spawn offsets for AI bikes on the starting grid, relative to track.start.position. Single source of truth shared by the runtime (src/boot/spawn-bikes.ts) and the Blender addon's racer-at-start preview.

dx.description: Offset along world +X from the player start.

dz.description: Offset along world +Z from the player start (negative = behind).

lineOffset.description: Lateral racing-line bias the AI controller holds, in metres.
